messages.subject: Hyperprior default
parts:
We are working in a Poisson model using the default hyperprior Gamma. We wonder why Gamma is the default hyperprior for the random effects.

Thanks,

Pablo Juan

messages.author: 9a89594e7fcb7aad
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Hyperprior default
parts:
On Mon, 2013-07-08 at 10:18 -0700, Pablo Juan Verdoy wrote:
> We are working in a Poisson model using the default hyperprior Gamma.
> We wonder why Gamma is the default hyperprior for the random effects.

Hi,

for Gaussian random effect with random precision, then the Gamma is
conjugate as a prior for the precision. so this is why. you can easily
chose another one, or define your own prior for log(precision) and do
ths anylysis with that.

Best
H
